title: Katherine Vacca Exhibits at Cape Cod Five

bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder February 9, 2018

Member Katherine Vacca is showing her watercolor paintings at the Cape Cod Five Cent Savings Bank in Harwich Port. The exhibit is on view during regular banking hours through the month of February.

Posted in BANK SHOWS, EVENTS, WHAT'S NEW
Tagged Cape Cod Five, Guild of Harwich Artists
